items.reasons: It is drawn as a flat front elevation, a tall narrow cabinet with no lit top plane, and at 1x it is a thin noisy sliver that doesn't read as a drink bar. The grey bottle-shelf top and wood-drawer bottom look like two different pieces stacked, and the bottles are noisy white and coloured specks.

Pure front elevation: the red header band with white squares sits right on the top edge, and there is no top surface seen from above, unlike mci-cooler's slanted top plane. A detached tan strip floats above the body in the 4x view, outside the object's outline.

Flat front view of two shelves with no top plank visible from above and no short front face. The snacks are saturated yellow-orange blobs with heavy dark outlines, which look muddy and sticker-like against the chipset's muted palette.
